summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned /tablet kiosk page. Logged in with tablet@burgertimes.fr and validated every requested behaviour: page renders, live clock, 9 category tabs each with lucide icons, product grid populated by default and switches on tab click, cart empty-state, add-to-cart flow via MenuItemCard modal, quantity +/- steppers update total, clear-cart works, all 3 fulfillment buttons present (pickup/delivery/dine_in) and mutually toggleable, delivery reveals address+city with NO postal code field, pickup and dine_in hide address, no email input anywhere on the page, no payment-method selector, phone lookup calls backend without crashing (shows 'Aucun client trouvé' toast for unknown numbers and suggestions dropdown for known prefixes), and the Valider/Encaisser button correctly toggles disabled/enabled based on required fields (items + first name + phone; for delivery also address + city; postal not required). Order was NEVER submitted per agent instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: TabletOrder.jsx is ~696 lines; still readable but approaching the 700 line soft limit. Consider extracting FulfillmentButton, Field, CategoryTabs and CustomerSearch into their own files if further growth is expected.

In lookupCustomer, spreading data.customer into form via {...current, ...data.customer, phone: parts.number} silently drops fields not in initialForm and could overwrite address1/city with undefined if the backend returns a different shape. A whitelist/explicit mapping would be safer.

cartPayload effect dependency list uses items.length instead of cartPayload/items which can miss updates when only line contents change (e.g. sauce edit) without qty change. Minor; not blocking the requested scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 tablet kiosk acceptance criteria verified end-to-end via Playwright at 1280x800 without submitting a real order. Add-to-cart flow: click the 'Ajouter' button on a MenuItemCard, then click the modal's 'Ajouter' button (label is 'Ajouter', NOT 'Ajouter au panier'). Backend dine_in and tablet-delivery-without-postal were already curl-verified per the request.
